rows.quote: Discovery datasets for cis-pQTLs associated with protein levels were derived from a proteome-wide GWAS from the deCODE study (n = 35,559), identifying 1,881 sentinel cis-pQTLs linked to 1,809 proteins [11].
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E Sulem P Atlason BA Sveinbjornsson G Magnusson MI Styrmisdottir EL Gunnarsdottir K Helgason A Oddsson A Halldorsson BV Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease Nat Genet 2021 53 12 1712 1721 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w 34857953
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the discovery cis-pQTLs to the deCODE study (n = 35,559) with citation [11]; the entry DOI is the Ferkingstad 2021 row source only.
